titulo: Donald Trump meets Irish president in Dublin as he begins two-day visit – live
cuerpo: US president is meeting politicians and business leaders, as well as playing golf Tánaiste Simon Harris has been speaking to reporters at Dublin airport after Trump’s arrival. He said he was “pleased to be here on behalf of the Irish government to welcome the president of the United States to Ireland”. “He’s very much looking forward to getting to Doonbeg,” he said, according to PA.
